svg.title: Escalation ladder
svg.desc: Three stacked boxes with arrows between them. Bottom, tag 1, gray: Skill, success, or a failure result. Middle, tag 2, blue: Behavior tree, retry, wait, timeout, other branch. Top, tag 3, red: Planner or LLM agent, new plan or new goal. Arrows on the left point up, labeled status and failure result move up. Arrows on the right point down, labeled commands move down. On the far right, a blue bracket labeled local spans the skill and the tree, and a red bracket labeled global spans the planner or agent.
